scenarios.name: a child sees and edits only their own assignments; an adult sees every child's

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_homework_grades__assignments (id, member_id, subject, title, due_date, status, grade, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('a_a', ?, 'Math', 'Fractions worksheet', '2026-01-10', 'pending', '', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'), ('a_b', ?, 'Science', 'Volcano report', '2026-01-12', 'graded', 'B+', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
SELECT id FROM app_homework_grades__assignments WHERE id = 'a_b'
UPDATE app_homework_grades__assignments SET grade = 'A+' WHERE id = 'a_b'
UPDATE app_homework_grades__assignments SET status = 'submitted' WHERE id = 'a_a'
SELECT id, status, grade FROM app_homework_grades__assignments
